text:
Harper (CS): heads-up — we had a SAML assertion delay that caused some onboarding flows to time out overnight. about 9 tenants affected, 2 are up for renewal in 2 weeks. I've added the impacted list to the incident doc: https://redwood.share/inc/1745604321 :triage_flag:

IncidentBot: INCIDENT-2026-2765 | Severity: P2 | Affected: 9 onboarding tenants | Oncall alerted

Jordan (Onboard): saw several stuck connector steps. a handful resumed after retry but 3 customers reported failed first-login. renewal-risk: those 2 accounts we should prioritize.

Mei (Eng): root cause: external IdP had a sporadic clock skew causing assertions to be rejected; we widened tolerance and queued retry handler at 00:50 UTC. backfill completed by 01:22 UTC. will provide a 2-sentence RCA for customers.

Harper (CS): comms plan: 1) quick status note to all impacted (non-technical); 2) prioritized 1:1 outreach to the 2 renewal accounts offering scheduling + 5 days credits; 3) log outcomes and capture renewal sentiment. need AM sign-off and legal quick-review.

Rashid (AM): please add me to those two accounts. I'll take the 1:1 and draft account-specific notes. credits OK from my side.

LegalBot: Suggested phrasing: avoid wording that implies SLA violation. keep it factual and offer remediation options. legal review complete.

Harper (CS): Draft outbound (short):

"Hi <Name>,

We experienced a brief authentication delay last night which affected some onboarding sessions. The issue is resolved and we completed a catch-up. We're sorry for the disruption. We'd like to offer a complimentary 1:1 enablement session and 5 days of credits. Reply if you'd like us to prioritize your migration.

— Harper, Customer Success"

Mei (Eng): RCA blurb for email: "Cause: transient clock skew between our service and a third-party IdP that caused SAML assertions to be rejected briefly. Fix: adjusted tolerance and added retry window; backlog processed. Impact window: 00:12–00:50 UTC."

Jordan (Onboard): I'll run the prioritized outreach list and flag any renewal concerns back to Rashid. can CS include a 1-click troubleshooting checklist for calls?

Mei (Eng): added checklist to doc: `sync-clock -> re-trigger-auth -> verify login success`

Harper (CS): Action items:
- send status email to all impacted within 60 minutes (owner: Harper)
- AM 1:1 outreach for renewals (owner: Rashid)
- eng to drop RCA blurb into email template (owner: Mei)
- log outcome & survey: 1–5 disruption scale + renewal sentiment (owner: Jordan)

Jordan (Onboard): I'll attach a short survey after calls and mark responses <=2 for AM follow-up.

Harper (CS): we'll follow up with a 48-hour RCA note and host an optional office hour for any customers who want a walkthrough. I'll post the outbound copy in #customer-success once legal approves. :white_check_mark:
